title: Cedar, by the risk it changes
summary: A policy language and engine whose decisions default to deny: if no policy permits a request, the answer is no. Written as an answer, that is read-only access where only reading is permitted and the application holding the data enforces the decision.

baseline.why: The model's typical deployment, with the answers this project addresses stated as they are without it: can read and change the data in its reach.

does.text: Authorisation decisions that deny when nothing permits.
does.quote: Otherwise (i.e., no policy is satisfied), the final result is Deny.

changes.why: Only where the application holding the resource enforces the decision the agent cannot override.

basis.quote: Otherwise (i.e., no policy is satisfied), the final result is Deny.

adds_note: Its documentation states that a policy whose evaluation errors is skipped: *if a policy's evaluation returns error, the policy does not factor into the authorization response*. A forbid policy that errors therefore does not deny.
adoption: Write the policies for your own resources and actions.
Test the forbid policies for errors, because an erroring forbid is skipped.
Enforce in the application that holds the data.
does_not_claim: That it was tested. Nothing was installed or run; every change rests on the documentation quoted beside it.
next: Published, and sent to the project's maintainers at the same time. If a change is wrong, or another answer should move, the case changes with the date they said so.
